title: Rectified flow loss and Euler sampler
summary: Interpolate along straight paths, regress the velocity x1 - x0 with the flow matching loss, and integrate a velocity field with Euler steps.

paper.title: Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow

mutants.euler_in_place: Updates x with += on an array that shares memory with x0, so the input of the caller changes.
mutants.euler_one_step_short: Loops over num_steps - 1 steps, so the sample stops before t = 1.
mutants.euler_time_at_end: Reads the velocity at the end of each step, (k + 1) / n, not at its start.
mutants.interpolation_swapped: Puts the weight t on x0 and 1 - t on x1, so the path runs backward.
mutants.mean_over_all_elements: Takes the mean of the squared error over every element, not the sum over features and the mean over the batch.
mutants.target_reversed: Uses x0 - x1 as the target velocity, so the sign is wrong.
